questions.stem:
A transition metal 'M' among $\mathrm{Sc}$, $\mathrm{Ti}$, $\mathrm{V}$, $\mathrm{Cr}$, $\mathrm{Mn}$ and $\mathrm{Fe}$ has the highest second ionisation enthalpy. The spin only magnetic moment value of $\mathrm{M^{+}}$ ion is ______ BM (Near integer)
(Given atomic number $\mathrm{Sc}$ : 21, $\mathrm{Ti}$ : 22, $\mathrm{V}$ : 23, $\mathrm{Cr}$ : 24, $\mathrm{Mn}$ : 25, $\mathrm{Fe}$ : 26)
questions.solution:
Among given metals, Cr has maximum $\mathrm{IE_2}$
because Second electron is removed from stable configuration $3d^{5}$
$\mathrm{Cr^{+}}$ : $\mathrm{[Ar]\,3d^{5}4s^{0}}$
$\therefore$ No of unpaired $e^{-}$ in $\mathrm{Cr^{+}}$ is 5, n = 5
So, Magnetic moment = $\sqrt{n(n+2)}$ B.M
$= \sqrt{5(5+2)} = 5.92\ \mathrm{BM} \approx 6$

questions.stem: The vapour pressure of pure benzene and methyl benzene at $27^\circ\mathrm{C}$ is given as 80 Torr and 24 Torr, respectively. The mole fraction of methyl benzene in vapour phase, in equilibrium with an equimolar mixture of those two liquids (ideal solution) at the same temperature is____$\times 10^{-2}$ (nearest integer)
questions.solution:
$X_{\mathrm{methylbenzene}} = 0.5$
$Y_{\mathrm{methylbenzene}} = \frac{P_{\mathrm{methylbenzene}}}{P_{\mathrm{total}}}$
$Y_{\mathrm{methylbenzene}} = \frac{0.5 \times 24}{0.5 \times 80 + 0.5 \times 24}$
$= \frac{12}{40 + 12} = 0.23 = 23 \times 10^{-2}$

In the given TLC, the distance of spot A & B are 5 cm & 7 cm, from the bottom of TLC plate, respectively.
$R_f$ value of B is $x \times 10^{-1}$ times more than A. The value of x is_____.
questions.solution:
$R_f = \frac{\text{Distance moved by substance from base line}}{\text{Distance moved by solvent from base line}}$
$(R_f)_A = \frac{4}{8}$, $(R_f)_B = \frac{6}{8}$
$\frac{(R_f)_B}{(R_f)_A} = \frac{6}{8} \times \frac{8}{4}$
$(R_f)_B = 1.5\,(R_f)_A$
$x = 15$

questions.stem:
Based on Heisenberg's uncertainty principle, the uncertainty in the velocity of the electron to be found within an atomic nucleus of diameter $10^{-15}$ m is ______$\times 10^{9}\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$ (nearest integer)
[Given : mass of electron = $9.1 \times 10^{-31}$ kg, Plank's constant (h) = $6.626 \times 10^{-34}$ Js]
(Value of $\pi$ = 3.14)
questions.solution:
$m\Delta V.\Delta x = \frac{h}{4\pi}$
$\Delta V = \frac{6.626 \times 10^{-34}}{9.1 \times 10^{-31} \times 10^{-15} \times 4 \times 3.14}$
$= 57.97 \times 10^{+9}$ m/sec

questions.stem: Total number of electron present in $(\pi^{*})$ molecular orbitals of $\mathrm{O_2}$, $\mathrm{O_2^{+}}$ and $\mathrm{O_2^{-}}$ is_______.
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{O_2}$ (16e) : $(\sigma_{1s})^{2}(\sigma_{1s}^{*})^{2}(\sigma_{2s})^{2}(\sigma_{2s}^{*})^{2}(\sigma_{2p})^{2}\left[(\pi_{2p})^{2}=(\pi_{2p})^{2}\right],\left[(\pi_{2p}^{*})^{1}=(\pi_{2p}^{*})^{1}\right]$
Number of $e^{-}$ present in $(\pi^{*})$ of $\mathrm{O_2}$ = 2
Number of $e^{-}$ present in $(\pi^{*})$ of $\mathrm{O_2^{+}}$ = 1
Number of $e^{-}$ present in $(\pi^{*})$ of $\mathrm{O_2^{-}}$ = 3
So total $e^{-}$ in $(\pi^{*})$ = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6

questions.stem: When $\Delta H_{vap}$ = 30 kJ/mol and $\Delta S_{vap}$ = 75 J $\mathrm{mol^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$, then the temperature of vapour, at one atmosphere is ______K.
questions.solution:
At equilibrium $\Delta G_{PT} = 0$
$\Delta H_{vap} = T\Delta S_{vap}$
$30 \times 1000 = T \times 75$
$T = 400\ \mathrm{K}$
